Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajesh Kumar Gupta

On The 6 th Of November, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 46230 of 2025
 Ramlakhan Singh
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Ms. Nikita Jain - Advocate for the applicant.
 Dr. Anjali Gyanani - Pp for the State.
 Order
This is the first application under Section 482 of BNSS for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.394/2024 registered at Police Station Civil Lines, District Morena for the offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A, 34 of IPC..
2.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Lines, District Morena
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the story of prosecution, the marriage of the deceased was solemnized with the co-accused- Ramvaran Singh on 18.02.2018.
The allegation present applicant is that he along with other co-accused persons was mentally and physically harassing the deceased for demand of dowry.
Rs.2 lac was demanded from the deceased as dowry by the present applicant and other co-accused persons.
Due to the aforesaid demand and the mental and physical harassment, the deceased committed suicide on 22.06.2024 by hanging herself.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:28094 2 MCRC-46230-2025 3.
It is submitted by counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased aged about 68 years.
It is further submitted that the present applicant lives separately with family of deceased.
The son of the present applicant along with his wife/deceased lives separately in their house.
In support of his contention, counsel for the applicant filed samagra ID.
The factum of separate living has been verified by the State as well as Gram Panchayat.
A sale deed has also been produced herein which shows that the son of the present applicant is living separately at Morena with his wife/deceased.
There is no direct of indirect involvement of the present applicant in the aforesaid offence.

No specific role is attributed to the present applicant and only omnibus allegations have been levelled Ramlakhan Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28302585/
1 against him.

entities.text: Ramlakhan Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal or tainted background.
In the present context, the custodial interrogation is not required as investigation is almost complete.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Morena, therefore, there is no apprehension of his absconsion and final conclusion of trial will take long sufficient time.
Hence, on these grounds, he prays that applicant be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned State counsel, vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection by submitting that investigation is pending that many truths are yet to come to fore.

5. Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.
6.

In view of facts and circumstances of the case and looking to fact of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:28094 3 MCRC-46230-2025 separate living of the present applicant, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and in the event of arrest, the applicant be released on bail on executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer /Investigating Authority.
7.

The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 482 (2) of the B.N.S.S. and shall cooperate in the investigation, otherwise this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
8. Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJESH KUMAR GUPTA ) JUDGE Vishal Ramlakhan Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28302585/
